title: Construction progress
description: Track the construction phase and % of works per project or building. Clients are notified with site photos when progress advances.

help.title: Construction progress
help.overview: A construction progress report records which phase a project (or one building) is in and what % of the works is done, with site photos. When a report moves progress forward, every client holding a unit in that project or building — buyers and active reservations — gets an in-app notification and an email with the photos.

sections.title: What it holds
items: Construction phase, % of works completed, update date and expected completion.
A title, a message to clients and up to 20 site photos.

sections.title: Client notifications
items: Sent automatically when the report advances the phase or the % compared to the previous report, and "Notify clients" is on.
A report without a building notifies all clients of the project; with a building, only that building's clients.
Use "Resend notifications" on a report to send it again at any time.

sections.title: Where it shows
items: The latest phase and % appear on the project and building sheets.
Edits and deletions update those values but do not notify clients.
